moments.text: Close infrared view of grey sky: two slanted lines of about ten bright round dots each, one across the crosshair, one lower left.
The view zooms out: the picture shrinks inside a grey border. The upper line slides to the right of the crosshair; the lower line stays lower left.
The two lines move apart: the upper one toward the right edge, the lower one to just below the crosshair.
Both lines drift back left; the upper line ends just right of the crosshair, the lower line lower left.
